h1: The Nouveau Chumphon Beach Resort and Golf — A Spacious Seafront Resort That's Rare in Chumphon
intro: If the name Novotel Chumphon rings a bell, this is the same place — rebranded as The Nouveau Chumphon Beach Resort and Golf, still one of the largest seafront resorts in Chumphon. Set in the Pak Nam area just minutes from the beach, it has 86 contemporary rooms, an outdoor pool and a 9-hole golf course on the same grounds. Rooms from approx ฿2,590/night. Score 8.3 from 71 Trip.com reviews.
galleryAlts: Outdoor pool at The Nouveau Chumphon set in wide gardens by the sea
Contemporary wood-trimmed guest room with a private balcony
Seafront grounds of the resort in Pak Nam Chumphon

body.html: The first thing guests mention is space. The Nouveau Chumphon sits on a large seafront plot with a 9-hole golf course as its backdrop, so it feels far more open and private than a town resort. Sea breeze runs through the grounds all day, and most visitors come here to escape the bustle rather than for flash.

All 86 rooms are done in a contemporary style with wooden furnishings. Entry-level Superior Garden rooms are a good size, with a work desk, a private balcony, and in some cases a pool or sea view. Real reviews praise the spacious rooms, comfy beds and big bathtubs — well suited to a slow stay. The honest trade-off: some furniture and bathrooms are starting to show their age, a few rooms are dimly lit, and there are reviews mentioning a musty smell in older rooms.
"Huge room, soft bed. Opened the curtains to a view of the pool and green trees, cool sea breeze, so quiet I slept beautifully."

The outdoor pool gets plenty of love — large, clean water, a separate kids' pool and shady surrounds. There's a kids' club, a gym and massage/spa services. The original draw, the 9-hole golf course, is still here, but check before booking: recent reviews note the course was closed for a major renovation, so if golf is your main reason to come, call the resort first to confirm.

On service, the staff are a recurring highlight — friendly, smiling and helpful. Breakfast has a decent spread and is included in many packages. The resort is about 3 minutes' drive from Pak Nam Chumphon beach and around 5 minutes from the King Chumphon shrine, a key local landmark. Note that the beach out front is a natural mainland Gulf-of-Thailand beach, not a white-sand island shore — in places, wind-blown plastic and rubbish wash up, which is part of the reality of this coast.

Honestly, The Nouveau Chumphon is not a brand-new luxury resort. It's a former Novotel that has seen years of use — some corners are dated, some areas await refurbishment. What you get in return is wide grounds, big rooms, a lovely pool, real quiet and an affordable 4-star price — from about ฿2,590 for a Superior Garden, rising to suites in the five figures at peak. For anyone driving through Chumphon or wanting an easy seaside break, it's a sensible pick.

A tip from reading many reviews: ask for a recently refurbished room facing the pool or sea, because room quality here is uneven. If you're travelling with family or young children, the pool and kids' club are where you'll get the most value. And since the resort is out of town, have your own car or arrange a Grab in advance — public transport around here is scarce.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — The Nouveau Chumphon Beach Resort and Golf

faq.q: Is The Nouveau Chumphon the former Novotel Chumphon?
faq.a: Yes. This is the former Novotel Chumphon Beach Resort and Golf, rebranded as The Nouveau Chumphon Beach Resort and Golf. The buildings, grounds and facilities are the same.

faq.q: Where is it, and is it really on the sea?
faq.a: It's in the Pak Nam area of Mueang Chumphon, on a seafront plot facing the Gulf of Thailand. About 3 minutes from Pak Nam beach and 5 minutes from the King Chumphon shrine. It's a mainland Gulf beach, not a white-sand island shore.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what rooms are there?
faq.a: From approx ฿2,590/night for a Superior Garden. Superior Pool Side is around ฿3,178, with Sea View and Suite rooms rising at peak. Many packages include breakfast for two — always compare platforms before booking.

Great for families with young children, drivers passing through Chumphon, and anyone wanting a quiet seaside stay. Big pool, wide grounds, good value. Less ideal if you expect a brand-new luxury resort or white island sand.

faq.q: Is the golf course still open?
faq.a: There's a 9-hole course on the grounds, but recent reviews note it was closed for a major renovation. If golf is your main reason to come, call 077-529529 to confirm status before booking.

faq.q: Can I get to Koh Tao from here?
faq.a: Yes. The Pak Nam Chumphon pier for Koh Tao and Koh Phangan is about 10 minutes' drive away, making this a convenient base before catching a boat. Ask the resort to help arrange a transfer to the pier.
